QUOTE: "The exception is the async-ask worker, which is detached and not joined on destroy." and "ExternalBridge async ask `run_async_ask` (`:1158`, detached at `:1222`)"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer identifies the async-ask worker as the one detached thread and states it has no join, so it outlives its caller and can run after the handle is destroyed.
